label: One green action per screen
title: Use Comet Green for one action per screen
body: Comet Green marks the single most important action on a screen. Everything else uses Ink, Kiln White, and neutral grays.
do: Use Comet Green for the main button
Set text on Comet Green in Kiln White
dont: Color two buttons green on the same screen
Use Comet Green for body text

label: Logo clear space
title: Keep clear space around the logo
body:
Leave space on every side of the logo equal to the height of the comet head. Nothing else sits inside that space.

Use the reversed logo on Ink or Comet Green. Use the full color logo on Kiln White or white.
do: Use the file that matches the background
Scale the logo from the corner so it keeps its shape
dont: Stretch, rotate, or recolor the logo
Place the full color logo on a dark photo

label: Icon style
title: Draw icons on a 24px grid with a 2px stroke
body: Icons use a 24 by 24 grid, a 2px stroke, and round caps and joins. Use one icon color per screen, taken from the icon colors on the Icons page.
do: Pair an icon with a text label in buttons
dont: Fill icons with a second color
Mix icon sets from other sources

label: Photo style
title: Photograph in natural light
body: Photos show real teapots in use, lit by daylight. Keep backgrounds plain and colors true to life.
do: Keep steam and pouring in frame when it tells the story
dont: Use stock photos of tea we do not make

label: Headshot standard
title: Take headshots against Kiln White
body: Headshots are shoulders up, centered, against a plain Kiln White wall, in daylight. Export at 1200 by 1200 pixels.
do: Face the camera with eyes level with the lens
dont: Use photos older than two years

label: Template text
title: Keep template text in Inter
body: Templates set all text in Inter. Change words and photos, not fonts, colors, or layout.
do: Replace sample text with your own
Keep the logo where the template places it
dont: Move the logo out of its clear space
